title: Build a grouped BOM from the BOM Manager, the project or the PCB
summary: Generates a bill of materials four ways: from the BOM engine (IBomManagerFactory) of a document, from the compiled project with its current variant, and from the components of a PCB, grouped by parameter values and written to a text file.
phrasings: generate a bill of materials from code
read BOM rows and columns with the BOM manager
group components by comment and footprint
list PCB components with their parameters
apply the current variant to a BOM

commands.name: GenerateBom
commands.description: Build a grouped BOM and write it to a text file
commands.params: Source=Schema|BomManager|Project|Pcb (default Schema)|GroupBy=Comment,Footprint|Out=<file or folder> (default: temp folder)|Max=<n> (rows returned, default 5, 0 = all)|Update=true (optional)
